title: Nord USB device catalog
description: Source of truth for per-instrument USB/protocol constants. See devices/README.md for how to add a new instrument, and docs/PROTOCOLS.md for the wire protocol these values are used by.

schemaVersion.description: Bump only on a breaking change to this shape. New optional fields with safe defaults don't need a bump.

programCategories.description: The master preset-category-tag catalog, id -> name, shared across the whole Nord product line (54 ids, 0-53). No instrument implements all of it: each device entry picks its own subset via 'programCategoryIds'. Keyed by id rather than by name because the master list is not injective - ids 2 and 37 are both 'Wind', 14 and 43 both 'User' - so a name -> id map cannot represent it.

id.description: Stable machine id, e.g. 'nord_grand'. Not currently read by either app, but a device needs one so profiles can be referenced (test fixtures, future tooling) without depending on array order.

name.description: Human-readable name shown to the user, e.g. 'Nord Grand'.

maxBankLetter.description: Last valid bank letter for preset ids, e.g. 'P' or 'D'.

maxGroup.description: Last valid group number for preset ids.

slotsPerGroup.description: Slots per group - the divisor used to translate group/slot into a flat item index.

maxDisplayTextLen.description: Character width of the instrument's status-message display.

maxProgramNameLen.description: Longest program name the instrument actually stores. Measured, not guessed: an oversized SET_NAME is accepted with status 0 and the instrument silently keeps this many characters. Separate from maxDisplayTextLen even though both are 16 on every instrument measured so far - they are different limits that happen to coincide, and conflating them would hide the day one of them moves.

supportedFirmwareVersions.description: Firmware version codes (as returned by the bRequest=4 control transfer, e.g. 168 for '1.68') this profile has been verified against. An empty array means 'skip the firmware check' - used for a device nobody has captured yet, not for a real supported instrument.

programCategoryIds.description: Which ids of the top-level programCategories master list this instrument actually offers - an index into it, not a redefinition of it. The Nord Grand and Stage 2 EX offer the identical 21. Optional: omitting it (or null) means 'this instrument's subset has not been established', which resolves to no known names at all, so the app offers no category editing rather than guessing. Unlike every other per-device value here it cannot be read off the instrument: the wire only ever carries the numeric id.

programCategoryNameOverrides.description: Ids from 'programCategoryIds' that this instrument displays under a different name than the master list gives them, id -> name. Both current instruments relabel 23/24 ('EPiano'/'Wurl' in the master list) as 'EPiano1'/'EPiano2'. An id here that is absent from 'programCategoryIds' is ignored.
